explanation: Founder Edwin Land said the idea came when his young daughter asked why she could not see a photo straight away. The camera produced a finished print in about a minute.

claims.text: Polaroid launched its instant camera, the Land Camera Model 95, in 1948.
Kodak, Leica and Fujifilm did not launch an instant camera in 1948.
Edwin Land said the idea for instant photography came when his young daughter asked why she could not see a photograph at once.
The 1948 Polaroid camera produced a finished print in about a minute.
